crossRefs.note: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
because it is written, “You shall be holy; for I am holy.”
Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through…
It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.
For who is God, besides Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God?
Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
“You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and…
I myself am Yahweh. Besides me, there is no savior.
This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last…
Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a…
“Lord Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven…
He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation…
For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
“See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who…
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my…
Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.

translations.web: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.
translations.bsb: There is no one holy like the LORD. Indeed, there is no one besides You! And there is no Rock like our God.
translations.kjv: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.
translations.asv: There is none holy as Jehovah; For there is none besides thee, Neither is there any rock like our God.
